He confessed, evidence etc. The crime is illegal logging, which under Chinese law is "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging of forest trees). Also possibly "非法买卖林木" but the facts mention purchase of trees from others and illegal cutting. The main crime is "非法采伐林木罪". Could also be "破坏森林资源罪". In Chinese Criminal Law, Article 322 (formerly) deals with illegal logging: "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护的森林、林木或者其他林业资源的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the appropriate charge is "非法采伐林木罪". Also maybe "非法买卖林木罪" if he purchased and then sold? He purchased trees from others and then cut them illegally. The purchase itself may be illegal if the trees were from illegal sources, but the main act is illegal logging. The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". So only crimes directly supported: illegal logging. Could also be "伪造、变造森林资源登记证件" but not present. So answer: [罪名]非法采伐林木罪<eoa>.
